title: colorblindcheck: Check Color Palettes for Problems with Color Vision Deficiency
text: colorblindcheck accepts vector hexadecimal color descriptions input. can created using different existing R functions (e.g. rainbow()) packages (e.g. colorspace, RColorBrewer, rcartocolor, etc.). primary function package palette_check(), creates summary comparison original input palette simulations color vision deficiencies - deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia.  palette_check() function returns data.frame 4 observations 8 variables: name: original input color palette (normal), deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia n: number colors tolerance: minimal value acceptable difference colors distinguish ncp: number color pairs ndcp: number differentiable color pairs (color pairs distances tolerance value) min_dist: minimal distance colors mean_dist: average distance colors max_dist: maximal distance colors Additionally, plot comparing original input palette simulations color vision deficiencies - deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia can shown. help decide selected color palette colorblind friendly. example, output shows minimal distance colors input palette 12; however, minimum distance colors simulation tritanopia 2. can suggest colors palette distinguishable people color vision deficiencies. palette_dist() function calculates distances colors input palette, well simulation selected color vision deficiency - deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia. allows finding colors least similar compare behavior color palettes different color vision deficiencies. original rainbow_pal object, closest colors third fourth one (distance 12); however, deuteranopia version minimal distance 3 second third color.
